customer (Acme Corp): Hey team — started seeing a spike of 422s from our production calls to the tool "order_lookup" around 12:02 UTC. Happening on multiple routes. Request IDs: req_91a..., req_91b..., sample attached. Impact: checkout flows failing for ~5% of users.

maya (Support): Thanks for the heads up. Can you paste a full failing request payload and the exact error you get? Also a recent request-id and customer/org id so we can correlate logs.

customer (Acme Corp): Paste below (redacted customer ids):

```json
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "tool": "order_lookup",
  "input": {
    "orders": [ { "id": "ORD-12345" } ],
    "context": {"user_id": "acct-678"}
  }
}
```

Response:
```
422 Unprocessable Entity
{ "error": "tool args failed schema validation", "details": "expected object at path /input/order_id but got array" }
```

maya (Support): Got it. Repro steps? Can you confirm whether the payload used to work earlier today?

customer (Acme Corp): Yes — same payload worked at 11:58 UTC. First failed at 12:02 UTC. No deploys on our side.

maya (Support): Looping in Eng — @arkajit can you take a look? Attaching request-ids and raw logs to the ticket.

arkajit (Eng): looking now. Quick glance at router logs for req_91a shows gateway forwarded unchanged payload. Error originates in tool-schema validation layer. Can you paste the validation error log?

maya (Support): From our internal logs (sanitized):

```
[12:02:13.456Z] req=req_91a route=/v1/invoke model=redwood-chat-1 tool=order_lookup severity=ERROR msg="Tool validation failed" err="schema mismatch: expected object at /input/order_id got array" trace_id=tr_5566
[12:02:13.457Z] stack="validate_tool_args -> validate_order_lookup_args -> coerce_order_field"
```

arkajit (Eng): Interesting — the validator path indicates it's looking for /input/order_id (singular) but the client sent /input/orders (array). But the customer said this was working earlier. Possibility: tool schema was updated in canary to rename order_id -> orders and rollout partially applied.

lucas (SRE): Deploy-bot shows a canary rollout completed at 11:59 UTC for service svc-tooling: "schema-patch-2026-03-02". Canary flagged as successful but rollout set to gradual 50% at 12:00 then 100% at 12:05.

deploy-bot: Canary started: svc-tooling/schema-patch-2026-03-02 (canary id c-842) at 11:59:12 UTC. Gradual ramp to 50% at 12:00:00.

arkajit (Eng): Aha. That matches. If some routers are using old schema (expecting order_id) and some new (expecting orders array), mixed traffic could cause intermittent 422s. Need to confirm which revision each node is using.

maya (Support): Customer is getting ~5% failures which fits partial rollout. Customer requests immediate mitigation (rollback or gateway-level compatibility shim). They are P2.

arkajit (Eng): Proposed mitigations: 1) Roll back schema patch to previous revision (fast) OR 2) Add gateway compatibility shim that accepts either order_id or orders and coerces to canonical form (medium). Rollback first if safe.

lucas (SRE): Rollback is possible and quick. But we should check why canary proceeded to 50% without detecting schema incompatibility. Postmortem later. For now, I'll prepare rollback.

arkajit (Eng): Before rollback, can we run a script to detect nodes running new schema and route traffic away? If rollback now, it'll revert to previous stable and customer should be fine.

maya (Support): Customer asked for ETA. Customer (Acme Corp): please try to rollback; we need checkout to be functional ASAP.

lucas (SRE): Rolling back canary now. Executing: `kubectl set image deployment/svc-tooling svc-tooling=image:stable-2026-02-27 --namespace=prod`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by lucas at 12:07 UTC. Progress: 3/5 pods updated.

arkajit (Eng): while rollback proceeds, I'll push a compatibility shim to the gateway to accept both shapes. Patch: coerce `orders` array -> `order_id` if single-item array, or if `order_id` present leave alone. Quick fix will be a small middleware change.

maya (Support): Notifying customer: "We're rolling back a recent schema change and adding a temporary compatibility shim. Expecting errors to subside within ~5–8 minutes. Will update when complete." :thumbsup:

customer (Acme Corp): Thanks — standby.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 12:10 UTC. All pods replaced with stable-2026-02-27.

maya (Support): Can the customer confirm if errors stop?

customer (Acme Corp): Confirmed — errors dropped to 0.2% within 3 minutes. Checkout flow normal again. Huge thanks.

arkajit (Eng): Root cause summary (preliminary): a schema rename landed in canary (order_id -> orders array) and the validation layer did not have a backward-compatibility path. Canary progressed to partial rollout; mixed nodes caused intermittent 422s for clients still sending the older shape. Action items: revert change (done), create compatibility tests for schema rollouts, add gateway shim for safe coercion, add canary validation checks to detect schema-only incompatibilities. I'll open a PR with tests and retro.

lucas (SRE): Filing incident ticket and tagging postmortem. Also adding a monitoring rule: if tool validation 422 rate > 1% for >2 minutes during rollout, auto-pause rollout.

maya (Support): Closing loop with customer and creating internal ticket. Customer: we will follow up with timeline for permanent fix and PM follow-up.

customer (Acme Corp): Appreciate the fast turnaround.

arkajit (Eng): I'll link the PR/retro here when ready. For now marking as resolved.

maya (Support): Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
